## Generated by pol_build.py (COLDWAR_POL generator) from the approved design of 15.11.2026. Edit the generator or the design, not this file.
on_actions = {
	on_startup = {
		effect = {
			if = {
				limit = { POL = { exists = yes } }
				POL = {
					COLDWAR_POL_initialize = yes
					if = { limit = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_initialized NOT = { has_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_startup_factions_done } } set_country_flag = COLDWAR_POL_startup_factions_done COLDWAR_POL_setup_factions = yes }
					if = { limit = { COLDWAR_POL_1970_leader_supported = yes } COLDWAR_POL_install_leader = yes set_correct_ideology_trait = yes }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	on_monthly_POL = {
		effect = {
			COLDWAR_POL_initialize = yes
			COLDWAR_POL_monthly = yes
		}
	}
	on_ruling_party_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { original_tag = POL } COLDWAR_POL_sync_politics = yes }
		}
	}
	on_government_change = {
		effect = {
			if = { limit = { original_tag = POL } COLDWAR_POL_sync_politics = yes }
		}
	}
}
